summary: Deep learning system for training and running large AI models cheaper and faster with parallelism across many GPUs.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Colossal-AI is a system for making large AI models cheaper, faster and more accessible. It provides parallel training and inference tools for PyTorch so big models can run across many GPUs.
sixtySeconds.problem: Large models need lots of GPU memory and engineering to train. Colossal-AI packages parallelism and memory optimisations so teams can train and fine-tune them with less effort and cost.
whoFor: Researchers scaling experiments on GPU clusters
Teams fine-tuning big models on Linux
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a well-known open-source toolkit for large-model training with PyPI and Docker installs and many examples.
requirements: NVIDIA GPU with compute capability 7.0+ (V100/RTX 20 and newer)

overview: Install from PyPI with pip install colossalai. PyTorch extensions aren't built during install by default; CUDA kernels are built at runtime when needed, or set BUILD_EXT=1 to build them up front.
A weekly nightly build (colossalai-nightly) gives early access to unreleased features. A Docker image is published to Docker Hub on every release.
Only Linux is supported for now. The project is Apache 2.0 licensed.
limitations: Strict PyTorch and Python version ranges
